lines.en: -[ Sighs ]
Morning, Dwight.
-Who are you?
-[ Scoffs ] Who am I? I'm Jim.
We've been working together for 12 years.
Weird joke, Dwight.
-You're not Jim. Jim's not Asian.
lines.ko: 당신은 짐이 아니야. 짐은 아시아인이 아니라고

lines.en: -You seriously never noticed?
Hey. Hats off to you for not seeing race.
-All right, then, Jim. Uh, why don't you tell me
lines.ko: 좋아, 그럼 짐. 어제 성사시킨 계약에 대해

lines.en: about that sale that you made yesterday?
-Uh, Wellington Systems?
Sold them 10 cases of 24-pound letter stock.
Or were you talking about Krieger-Murphy?
Because I didn't close that one yet,
but I'm hoping I've got a voicemail from Paul Krieger
waiting for me.
-Please enter your password.
You have one new message.
-How did you know? No! No, no.
lines.ko: 어떻게 알았지? 안 돼! 안 돼, 안 돼

lines.en: That is sensitive information.
Only for employees, not outsiders!
lines.ko: 직원만 볼 수 있어, 외부인은 안 돼!

lines.en: -Dwight, cut it out. I'm trying to work.
-You don't work here! You're not Jim!
lines.ko: 넌 여기서 일 안 해! 짐이 아니야!

lines.en: -Jim, I got us that dinner reservation -- Grico's, 7:30.
-Oh, great. Can't wait.
Jim's at the dentist this morning,
and Steve is an actor friend of ours.
-I don't know who you are, but you are not Jim.
This is Jim!
Oh, my --
Oh, d-- Oh, how did -- Hunh!
